next_note: **The fresh-install journey was run end to end on 2026-11-18** (`bench/journey.py` -> `bench/results/2026-11-18-journey.json`): wheel install into a new venv, a real openai 3.51.0 app under `blackbox run` against a loopback origin, capture, ls/verify, diagnose, view, a repair proposal approved by token and verified by a rerun, then a second run that succeeds. All nine verdict rows are true. Running it found and fixed defects 77 (the proxy recorded every call `partial`, so diagnose claimed a cut stream for a complete 404), 78 (the seam judged a JSON body against the SSE terminator table, so non-streaming calls looked cut) and 79 (no finding for a 4xx status or a node that closed with an error); defect 80 came out of the fail-open suite when `close_call` grew the ending fields. B5 was widened the same day: `bench/bench_otlp_importers.py` -> `bench/results/2026-11-18-otlp-importers.json` shows the capsule's `otlp/spans.pb` accepted by the official OTLP messages (opentelemetry-proto 1.45.2 / protobuf 7.36.2) and by an OTLP/gRPC TraceService built from OTel's servicer (grpcio 1.85.3), and `otlp/spans.json` parsing as proto3 JSON strictly; the Collector, Tempo, Jaeger, Langfuse and Phoenix's gRPC listener stay unmeasured with the failing command recorded. **B4's fact also changed**: node-level edges are measured (`2026-11-18-b4-node-edges.json`, `node_level_edges_recorded: 2` with `node_join: exact` for an instrumented openai client; 0 and `unknown` for uninstrumented urllib/Node) and the ticket stays open as the owner's call. **Remaining:** B4's tick, B5's five unmeasured readers, B6's release-machine rows, and the macOS cells GitHub has not acquired.
